evidence: The TEM images reveal very conformal Al2O3 ALD on the ZrO2 nanoparticles. The Al2O3 ALD thicknesses versus number of Al(CH3)3 and H2O reactant exposures yielded an Al2O3 ALD growth rate of 2.0 Å per reactant cycle. The AES and XPS results are consistent with an Al2O3 ALD film that completely and conformally covered the underlying ZrO2 nanoparticle. The SAES measurements show that the Al2O3 ALD films are continuous and homogeneous on the ZrO2 nanoparticles.
